name: Executive first-view and simple three-tab journey
description: Checks the new minimal executive information architecture and same-source KPIs across the three tabs.
steps: Load the website with Essential mode selected
Read the four executive KPIs
Select Performance and view the Energy chart
Select Investment and inspect the NPV and year-one summary
Return to Explore and inspect the 3D model
expected: The overview shows four populated model-based KPIs, each tab shows only its own primary content, and 3D remains interactive without duplicated baseline cards.

name: Supplier price guardrail and quote
description: Switches between different equipment cases without silently applying the wrong EPC cost.
steps: Choose 456 kWp supplier in the global selector
Navigate to Investment
Verify NPV is CAPEX PENDING or Quote required
Enter USD 650000 as this scenario EPC budget
Verify NPV and IRR calculate for supplier case
Switch to 304 feasibility and check its separate financial input
expected: A missing supplier price blocks financial KPIs, entered price unlocks that case only, and 304 kWp feasibility retains its own EPC assumption.

name: Mobile intuitive exploration and hidden engineer tools
description: Verifies equipment exploration stays simple on mobile and detailed engineering controls are opt-in.
steps: Open Explore in Essential mode on a mobile viewport
Tap Equipment and choose Battery
Expand the technical details card and close it
Use Day / Night and the model hour slider
Switch Advanced on and inspect detailed camera controls
Switch Essential on again
expected: A compact equipment card shows battery capacity, the day/night time changes, and full technical controls appear only in Advanced mode.

name: Advanced optimization and executive report
description: Ensures the heavy optimizer loads only when explicitly enabled and the report is based on current selected assumptions.
steps: Choose Custom sizing from the top selector and confirm Advanced Performance view opens
Scroll to the Pareto sizing graph and select an equipment option
Apply that option to Custom design
Switch to Investment and inspect the missing custom EPC warning
Use the Executive report control and preview the printable decision brief
expected: Custom sizing updates technical performance without invented EPC NPV, and printable report includes source assumptions and screening limitations.
